meta.instructions: Fill in one object per employee-month under 'entries', following the 'example' rows below. Delete the example rows before handing this back for import. Each row creates ONE SALARY Payable (purpose: SALARY, payee.kind: EMPLOYEE) — for one employee, for one month. To pay the same employee for 3 months, add 3 rows (different period.month each).
meta.source: REPLACE with wherever this data actually comes from (e.g. 'Payroll sheet April-June 2026.xlsx')
meta.matching: Employees are matched by 'employeePhone' (must exactly match the phone number already on that employee's record) — 'employeeName' is carried along only so the sheet stays human-readable and is cross-checked against the matched employee's actual name, not used to look them up. If phone matching is unreliable for this data, say so and it can be switched to matching by name instead.
meta.duplicateGuard: The database enforces at most one SALARY payable per (employee, month, year) — a row that repeats an employee+period already imported will be skipped, not double-entered.

fieldNotes.employeeName: For readability/cross-check only. Not used to find the employee.
fieldNotes.employeePhone: REQUIRED. Must match an existing employee's phone exactly (digits only, as a string).
fieldNotes.period: REQUIRED. { month: 1-12, year: e.g. 2026 } — the month this salary is FOR, not the month it's being entered.
fieldNotes.amount: REQUIRED. The salary payable amount for this employee for this month (after any deduction/adjustment already applied for that month — enter the final owed figure, not the base salary, if they differ this month).
fieldNotes.branch: REQUIRED. One of the branch names used elsewhere in this app (e.g. 'Delhi', 'Hyderabad', 'Noida') — Employee records don't carry a branch of their own, so this has to be stated per row.
fieldNotes.dueDate: Optional, 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Defaults to the last day of the period month if omitted.
fieldNotes.remarks: Optional free text, e.g. 'April salary' or a note about a deduction.

entries._example: minimal example — only the required fields — delete this row
